description: Land Acquisition - Na-otunna, Devinuwara D/S Division, Matara District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2066/39, Mathugama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, extents, and claimants) for public purposes. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and deals with property acquisition, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
